title: Full Stack Developer (AI-Accelerated Workflows)
description:
Build high-performance web applications and modern backend systems, using AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery while maintaining enterprise-grade quality and security.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Fospe is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience to join our core engineering team. You will build high-performance web applications, manage modern backend and database systems, and orchestrate deployment pipelines. We embrace AI-assisted software development and expect you to use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Trae, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate delivery while carefully reviewing generated code for quality, security, and maintainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* ✓Build responsive, high-performance web interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern CSS.
* ✓Implement server-side rendering, static generation, and incremental static regeneration patterns for strong rendering and SEO performance.
* ✓Connect client applications to REST APIs, GraphQL services, and real-time backend systems.
* ✓Design and optimize backend workflows, API routes, database schemas, and data migrations.
* ✓Manage relational and backend-as-a-service databases, including MySQL, Supabase, and PostgreSQL, with attention to query performance and data consistency.
* ✓Deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS and serverless hosting platforms such as Vercel.
* ✓Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, preview deployments, and production releases.
* ✓Manage object storage for static assets, media processing, and document workflows.
* ✓Use AI coding assistants to accelerate implementation, boilerplate generation, refactoring, and debugging, then audit and refine generated code for security and architectural integrity.
* ✓Stay current with developer tools and practices that improve engineering quality and team delivery speed.

Mandatory Requirements

**Eligibility & Qualifications**
--------------------------------

* ✓3+ years of professional experience developing full-stack web applications.
* ✓Hands-on experience with React, Next.js (App Router or Pages Router), TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* ✓Proficiency with Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, and frontend state or data tools such as Redux, Zustand, or React Query.
* ✓Experience with Supabase, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, and an ORM such as Prisma or Drizzle.
* ✓Experience with AWS (including EC2 and S3), Vercel, Docker, and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions.
* ✓Strong backend and API skills with Node.js/Express, Next.js API routes, REST APIs, and WebSockets.
* ✓Practical experience using AI developer tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Trae, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, including reviewing AI-generated code.
* ✓Comfortable using Git with GitHub or GitLab.
* ✓Ability to work in a hybrid arrangement based in Kochi, India.

### **Preferred / Advantageous Qualifications**

* Experience building or operating enterprise SaaS products or multi-tenant architectures.
* Knowledge of serverless functions, edge computing, or AWS Lambda.
* Familiarity with vector databases or LLM integrations such as the OpenAI API, Anthropic API, or LangChain.

**Primary Technologies & Environment**
--------------------------------------

ReactNext.jsTypeScriptTailwind CSSNode.jsREST APIsGraphQLPostgreSQLMySQLSupabasePrismaDrizzle ORMAWSS3VercelDockerGitHub ActionsClaude CodeOpenAI CodexCursorGitHub Copilot

**Our Hiring Process**
----------------------

01

### **Application Review**

We review your full-stack experience, project history, and approach to AI-assisted development.

02

### **Technical Discussion**

Discuss frontend architecture, APIs, databases, cloud deployment, and code quality.

03

### **Practical Engineering Exercise**

Work through a role-relevant development task and explain how you validate and refine AI-assisted code.

04

### **Offer & Onboarding**

Align on the role, hybrid arrangement in Kochi, and onboarding plan.

#### **Summary Information**

title: Full Stack Dev
description:
***Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time***

**The Role**

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to build features for a production AI-powered SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe, and to own its quality. About half of the role is feature work across Next.js, React, and PostgreSQL. The other half is making sure every release works: end-to-end test suites, release checks, and the deployment pipeline. If you enjoy shipping features and take pride in catching what breaks before users do, this is the role. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **Product Features:** Build customer-facing flows end to end, mobile first, from database to UI
* **Accounts & Payments:** Implement sign-up, social login, roles and permissions, and online payment flows
* **Multi-Tenancy:** Build features that serve multiple business customers from one system, each with its own data and configuration
* **Admin Tools:** Build internal screens that let business users manage their data and settings
* **Quality Ownership:** Own the end-to-end test suite, regression checks, and sign-off for each release
* **DevOps:** Maintain deployment, hosting, domains, monitoring, and backups for a containerised application
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with tests as the safety net

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 2-5 years building and shipping web applications in production
* **Frontend:** React and Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, responsive and accessible UI
* **Backend & Data:** Node.js, PostgreSQL, an ORM such as Prisma, API design, and input validation
* **Authentication:** OAuth and social login, sessions, and role-based access (e.g. Auth.js / NextAuth)
* **Testing:** End-to-end testing with Playwright or similar, plus unit tests; the habit of starting a bug fix with a failing test
* **DevOps:** Docker, CI/CD, Linux servers, and basic monitoring and logging
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Daily, hands-on use of coding agents and the judgement to review what they produce
* **Bonus:** Payment providers (e.g. Stripe), multi-language applications, GDPR awareness, three.js or React Three Fiber, self-hosted deployment platforms, React Native or iOS development

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a German venture group that builds AI-first companies from the inside. We invest our own capital in AI startups (TAIWA, Nexora AI, Hurraay), build and run our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI builds for startups across Europe. Having operated in Germany since 2023, we're now opening an office in Berlin and a new office in India, in Kochi, and we're hiring the engineers who will build there.

* **Builders, not just investors:** We're engineers who invest. Product decisions are made by people who read the code
* **AI-native by default:** Coding agents, automated tests, and fast release cycles are how every team works here, not an experiment
* **More than one codebase:** Work across new ventures, our own products, and client builds instead of maintaining one system for years
* **Be early in Kochi:** Join the first engineers in our Kochi office, help shape how it works, and work hand in hand with the team in Berlin
* **A European quality bar:** Build for customers in Germany and across Europe, where privacy, multi-language support, and reliability are expected from day one

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1741325
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Application Engineering Senior Developer – .NET Full Stack \& Integrations**

  


**Application Engineer Lead**

  


**Job Summary:**



The Application Engineering Lead is responsible for designing, building, and owning complex full stack applications and enterprise integrations. This role requires deep technical expertise across .NET, API integrations, databases, and data pipelines, along with strong ownership of production systems, migration activities, and critical cutovers. The role operates with minimal supervision and serves as a key technical decision maker and escalation point.

  


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


**Application Development \& Integrations**


* Lead the design and implementation of **API integrations** using **REST, JSON**, and industry standard authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT, API keys, etc.).
* Lead the design and Implementation of Front end applications using Angular/HTML/Typescript
* Build and maintain **robust, secure, and scalable integrations** with structured error handling, logging, and retry mechanisms.
* Design and implement **reverse and batch integrations** across internal and external systems.
* Act as the **technical authority** for complex integration patterns, data flows, and migration solutions.


**Database \& Data Engineering**


* Design and develop **SQL Server solutions**, including complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and indexing strategies.
* Perform **production data fixes** with strong governance, validation, and audit controls.
* Implement and manage **ETL and data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and/or SSIS**.
* Handle **large scale, high volume data processing**, ensuring data accuracy, reconciliation, and integrity across systems.


**Production Ownership \& Reliability**


* Own **end to end accountability** for critical production systems and integrations.
* Lead **production issue triage, root cause analysis, and remediation,** maintaining composure and sound judgment during high severity incidents.
* Serve as a **trusted escalation point** during production issues, migration waves, and release cutovers.
* Ensure system stability, observability, and operational readiness across environments.


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**


* Operate independently with **minimal guidance**, making informed technical and delivery decisions.
* Act as a **subject matter expert (SME)** for integration and migration initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with **business stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams** to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Coordinate across multiple teams during migrations and production cutovers, ensuring aligned execution and clear communication.
* Mentor and guide engineers on integration patterns, coding standards, and operational best practices.

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**


**Frontend \& UI Engineering (Angular)**


* **Strong hands on experience with Angular (version 20\+) for enterprise grade web applications.**
* **Expertise in TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).**
* **Experience designing and implementing component based architectures, reusable modules, and shared UI libraries.**
* **Strong understanding of Angular lifecycle hooks, dependency injection, routing, and state management.**
* **Experience with RxJS and reactive programming, including observables, subjects, and subscription management.**
* **Ability to consume and integrate REST APIs into Angular applications with proper error handling and retry logic.**
* **Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms on the UI (token handling, role based access, guards).**
* **Proficiency in frontend performance optimization, change detection strategies, and lazy loading.**
* **Familiarity with responsive design and enterprise UI standards.**
* **Experience troubleshooting and resolving production UI issues with minimal supervision.**


**Core Technology Stack**


* Strong hands on experience with **.NET / .NET Core,** C\#, and full stack application development.
* Extensive experience with **RESTful API design and integration**, including:
	+ JSON payloads and schema validation
	+ Authentication and authorization mechanisms
	+ Structured error handling and resiliency patterns

**Databases \& Data Processing**


* Advanced expertise in **SQL Server**, including:
	+ Complex query design
	+ Stored procedures and performance optimization
	+ Controlled production data fixes
* Strong understanding of **data reconciliation, validation, and high volume data handling.**


**ETL \& Integration Platforms**


* Hands on experience with **Azure Data Factory (ADF)** and/or **SSIS**.
* Knowledge of batch processing, scheduling, and dependency management.
* Experience designing **scalable data pipelines** for enterprise integrations.

  


**Supervision Responsibilities:**


* Direct reports
* Working relationships (daily) with EY ITSD and AMS Lead
* Working relationships (daily) with TCS AMS team
* Liaison to the Business for that Portfolio / App

  


**Job Requirements:**


**Experience:**


* 6\+ years of experience in **application engineering / full stack development,** with significant exposure to enterprise integrations.
* Prior experience in **lead or senior technical roles** with ownership of production systems.
* Experience supporting **large migrations, platform transitions, or enterprise cutovers** is highly desirable.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
